subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed in cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose contexts, or should those detail-bearing warnings remain visible?
rationale: The PR asks for unconditional suppression, while current source comments and tests intentionally keep some detail-bearing exec warnings visible; automation cannot safely choose that user-facing policy.

options.title: Preserve detail-bearing warnings by default
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and narrow any suppression fix to the handled warning-noise cases.

options.title: Suppress every exec-like warning
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update the detail-mode tests to reflect the new hide-all policy.

options.title: Pause for more proof first
options.body: Ask for a live redacted reproduction and after-fix proof before deciding whether the existing detail warnings are harmful or useful.

recommendation.title: Preserve detail-bearing warnings by default
recommendation.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and narrow any suppression fix to the handled warning-noise cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the warning policy, mutation classifier, and handler paths involved in the decision.
